# `admin.user.totp-reset`

Reset a user second factor

Site admins only. Clears the TOTP secret, burns recovery codes, and optionally revokes sessions.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/totp-reset`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user totp-reset`
- MCP: `admin_user_totp-reset`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `revoke_sessions` | body | yes | `boolean` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
